description: Everything SCOM knows about one alert: summary, description, context, history and product knowledge.
title: SCOM Alert Details

list.name: ds_om
list.label: SCOM Operational DB
list.description: Microsoft SQL Server data source for the OperationsManager database. Chosen automatically if its name contains "Operational", "Operations" or "SCOM" (and not "Warehouse"/"DW"); otherwise pick it here.

options.content: **Alert details.** Open this page by selecting an alert name on [SCOM Alerts](/d/scom-core-alerts/scom-alerts) or in any *Active alerts* table. To look at a specific alert, paste its Alert ID into the box at the top.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT v.Property, v.Value
FROM (SELECT TOP 1 a.* FROM (SELECT al.AlertId AS Id, al.AlertName AS Name, al.AlertDescription AS Description, al.BaseManagedEntityId AS MonitoringObjectId, bm.DisplayName AS MonitoringObjectDisplayName, bm.FullName AS MonitoringObjectFullName, bm.Path AS MonitoringObjectPath, bm.TopLevelHostEntityId AS TopLevelHostEntityId, al.IsMonitorAlert, al.RuleId AS MonitoringRuleId, al.ResolutionState, al.Priority, al.Severity, al.Category, al.Owner, al.ResolvedBy, al.TimeRaised, al.LastModified, al.TimeResolved, al.RepeatCount, al.TicketId, al.Context, al.AlertParams, al.CustomField1, al.CustomField2, al.CustomField3, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringName, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 2 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringDescription FROM dbo.Alert al JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity bm ON bm.BaseManagedEntityId = al.BaseManagedEntityId) a WHERE a.Id = TRY_CAST(${alertid:singlequote} AS uniqueidentifier)) a
CROSS APPLY (VALUES
  (1,  'Alert',          CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(a.AlertStringName, ''), a.Name) AS nvarchar(4000))),
  (2,  'Severity',       CAST(CASE a.Severity WHEN 2 THEN 'Critical' WHEN 1 THEN 'Warning' ELSE 'Information' END AS nvarchar(4000))),
  (3,  'Priority',       CAST(CASE a.Priority WHEN 2 THEN 'High' WHEN 1 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS nvarchar(4000))),
  (4,  'Status',         CAST((SELECT TOP 1 rs.ResolutionStateName FROM dbo.ResolutionState rs WHERE rs.ResolutionState = a.ResolutionState) AS nvarchar(4000))),
  (5,  'Source',         CAST(a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName AS nvarchar(4000))),
  (6,  'Path',           CAST(a.MonitoringObjectPath AS nvarchar(4000))),
  (7,  'Computer',       CAST((SELECT TOP 1 c.DisplayName FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView c WHERE c.Id = a.TopLevelHostEntityId) AS nvarchar(4000))),
  (8,  'Raised (UTC)',   CONVERT(nvarchar(30), a.TimeRaised, 120)),
  (9,  'Last modified (UTC)', CONVERT(nvarchar(30), a.LastModified, 120)),
  (10, 'Resolved (UTC)', CONVERT(nvarchar(30), a.TimeResolved, 120)),
  (11, 'Repeat count',   CAST(a.RepeatCount AS nvarchar(20))),
  (12, 'Owner',          CAST(a.Owner AS nvarchar(4000))),
  (13, 'Resolved by',    CAST(a.ResolvedBy AS nvarchar(4000))),
  (14, 'Ticket ID',      CAST(a.TicketId AS nvarchar(4000))),
  (15, 'Category',       CAST(a.Category AS nvarchar(4000))),
  (16, 'Raised by',      CAST(CASE WHEN a.IsMonitorAlert = 1 THEN 'Monitor' ELSE 'Rule' END AS nvarchar(4000))),
  (17, 'Monitor or rule', CAST(a.Name AS nvarchar(4000))),
  (18, 'Custom field 1', CAST(a.CustomField1 AS nvarchar(4000))),
  (19, 'Custom field 2', CAST(a.CustomField2 AS nvarchar(4000))),
  (20, 'Custom field 3', CAST(a.CustomField3 AS nvarchar(4000))),
  (21, 'Alert ID',       CAST(a.Id AS nvarchar(40)))
) v(ord, Property, Value)
WHERE v.Value IS NOT NULL AND v.Value <> ''
ORDER BY v.ord

panels.title: Alert
panels.description: The alert as shown on the SCOM console Alert Details tab.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(
  COALESCE(NULLIF(a.Description, ''), a.AlertStringDescription),
  '{0}', COALESCE(p.x.value('(/AlertParameters/AlertParameter1)[1]', 'nvarchar(max)'), '{0}')),
  '{1}', COALESCE(p.x.value('(/AlertParameters/AlertParameter2)[1]', 'nvarchar(max)'), '{1}')),
  '{2}', COALESCE(p.x.value('(/AlertParameters/AlertParameter3)[1]', 'nvarchar(max)'), '{2}')),
  '{3}', COALESCE(p.x.value('(/AlertParameters/AlertParameter4)[1]', 'nvarchar(max)'), '{3}')),
  '{4}', COALESCE(p.x.value('(/AlertParameters/AlertParameter5)[1]', 'nvarchar(max)'), '{4}')),
  '{5}', COALESCE(p.x.value('(/AlertParameters/AlertParameter6)[1]', 'nvarchar(max)'), '{5}')),
  '{6}', COALESCE(p.x.value('(/AlertParameters/AlertParameter7)[1]', 'nvarchar(max)'), '{6}')),
  '{7}', COALESCE(p.x.value('(/AlertParameters/AlertParameter8)[1]', 'nvarchar(max)'), '{7}')),
  '{8}', COALESCE(p.x.value('(/AlertParameters/AlertParameter9)[1]', 'nvarchar(max)'), '{8}')),
  '{9}', COALESCE(p.x.value('(/AlertParameters/AlertParameter10)[1]', 'nvarchar(max)'), '{9}')) AS Description
FROM (SELECT TOP 1 a.* FROM (SELECT al.AlertId AS Id, al.AlertName AS Name, al.AlertDescription AS Description, al.BaseManagedEntityId AS MonitoringObjectId, bm.DisplayName AS MonitoringObjectDisplayName, bm.FullName AS MonitoringObjectFullName, bm.Path AS MonitoringObjectPath, bm.TopLevelHostEntityId AS TopLevelHostEntityId, al.IsMonitorAlert, al.RuleId AS MonitoringRuleId, al.ResolutionState, al.Priority, al.Severity, al.Category, al.Owner, al.ResolvedBy, al.TimeRaised, al.LastModified, al.TimeResolved, al.RepeatCount, al.TicketId, al.Context, al.AlertParams, al.CustomField1, al.CustomField2, al.CustomField3, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringName, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 2 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringDescription FROM dbo.Alert al JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity bm ON bm.BaseManagedEntityId = al.BaseManagedEntityId) a WHERE a.Id = TRY_CAST(${alertid:singlequote} AS uniqueidentifier)) a
CROSS APPLY (SELECT TRY_CAST(a.AlertParams AS xml) AS x) p

panels.description: The alert description, with the alert parameters filled in.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT n.value('local-name(.)', 'nvarchar(200)') AS Field, n.value('.', 'nvarchar(max)') AS Value
FROM (SELECT TOP 1 TRY_CAST(a.Context AS xml) AS x FROM (SELECT al.AlertId AS Id, al.AlertName AS Name, al.AlertDescription AS Description, al.BaseManagedEntityId AS MonitoringObjectId, bm.DisplayName AS MonitoringObjectDisplayName, bm.FullName AS MonitoringObjectFullName, bm.Path AS MonitoringObjectPath, bm.TopLevelHostEntityId AS TopLevelHostEntityId, al.IsMonitorAlert, al.RuleId AS MonitoringRuleId, al.ResolutionState, al.Priority, al.Severity, al.Category, al.Owner, al.ResolvedBy, al.TimeRaised, al.LastModified, al.TimeResolved, al.RepeatCount, al.TicketId, al.Context, al.AlertParams, al.CustomField1, al.CustomField2, al.CustomField3, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringName, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 2 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringDescription FROM dbo.Alert al JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity bm ON bm.BaseManagedEntityId = al.BaseManagedEntityId) a WHERE a.Id = TRY_CAST(${alertid:singlequote} AS uniqueidentifier)) c
CROSS APPLY c.x.nodes('//*[not(*)]') AS t(n)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Context (raw)', CAST(a.Context AS nvarchar(max))
FROM (SELECT TOP 1 a.* FROM (SELECT al.AlertId AS Id, al.AlertName AS Name, al.AlertDescription AS Description, al.BaseManagedEntityId AS MonitoringObjectId, bm.DisplayName AS MonitoringObjectDisplayName, bm.FullName AS MonitoringObjectFullName, bm.Path AS MonitoringObjectPath, bm.TopLevelHostEntityId AS TopLevelHostEntityId, al.IsMonitorAlert, al.RuleId AS MonitoringRuleId, al.ResolutionState, al.Priority, al.Severity, al.Category, al.Owner, al.ResolvedBy, al.TimeRaised, al.LastModified, al.TimeResolved, al.RepeatCount, al.TicketId, al.Context, al.AlertParams, al.CustomField1, al.CustomField2, al.CustomField3, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringName, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 2 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringDescription FROM dbo.Alert al JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity bm ON bm.BaseManagedEntityId = al.BaseManagedEntityId) a WHERE a.Id = TRY_CAST(${alertid:singlequote} AS uniqueidentifier)) a
WHERE a.Context IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CAST(a.Context AS xml) IS NULL

panels.title: Alert context
panels.description: The data that triggered the alert (the console Alert Context tab): one row per field.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT h.TimeModified AS "Time (UTC)",
       COALESCE(rs.ResolutionStateName, CAST(h.ResolutionState AS varchar(10))) AS Status,
       h.Owner AS Owner, h.ModifiedBy AS "Modified by", h.Comments AS Comments, h.TicketId AS "Ticket ID"
FROM dbo.AlertHistory h
LEFT JOIN dbo.ResolutionState rs ON rs.ResolutionState = h.ResolutionState
WHERE h.AlertId = TRY_CAST(${alertid:singlequote} AS uniqueidentifier)
ORDER BY h.TimeModified DESC

panels.title: History
panels.description: State changes, owner and comments, newest first.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.value('(*[local-name()="title"])[1]', 'nvarchar(200)') AS Section,
       s.query('*[local-name()!="title"]').value('.', 'nvarchar(max)') AS Text
FROM (SELECT TOP 1 TRY_CAST(k.Content AS xml) AS x
      FROM dbo.KnowledgeView k
      WHERE k.KnowledgeReferenceId = (SELECT TOP 1 a.MonitoringRuleId FROM (SELECT al.AlertId AS Id, al.AlertName AS Name, al.AlertDescription AS Description, al.BaseManagedEntityId AS MonitoringObjectId, bm.DisplayName AS MonitoringObjectDisplayName, bm.FullName AS MonitoringObjectFullName, bm.Path AS MonitoringObjectPath, bm.TopLevelHostEntityId AS TopLevelHostEntityId, al.IsMonitorAlert, al.RuleId AS MonitoringRuleId, al.ResolutionState, al.Priority, al.Severity, al.Category, al.Owner, al.ResolvedBy, al.TimeRaised, al.LastModified, al.TimeResolved, al.RepeatCount, al.TicketId, al.Context, al.AlertParams, al.CustomField1, al.CustomField2, al.CustomField3, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringName, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 2 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringDescription FROM dbo.Alert al JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity bm ON bm.BaseManagedEntityId = al.BaseManagedEntityId) a WHERE a.Id = TRY_CAST(${alertid:singlequote} AS uniqueidentifier)) AND k.Visible = 1
      ORDER BY CASE WHEN k.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, k.LanguageCode) c
CROSS APPLY c.x.nodes('//*[local-name()="section"]') AS t(s)

panels.title: Product knowledge
panels.description: Knowledge from the management pack for the monitor or rule that raised this alert (Summary, Causes, Resolutions...).
